# Corpus for internal/cconv: strings fed to C strtol() and strtod().
# Format: see reference/harness/cconv/README.md. Every case line starts
# with '>'; escapes: \\ (backslash), \xHH (byte), \R<n>:<HH> (byte HH n times).
